resources.string: Quiet notification that keeps Sonne reachable.
Shows the ringing screen when the phone is rung remotely.
Someone is ringing this phone remotely.
The test takes exactly the same path as a remote ring: maximum volume, vibration, flashlight and ringing screen.
Without them, Sonne may not ring in silent mode or may stop being reachable.
Scan the pairing code from the device that will act as the remote, then write down the 12 words.
Android can no longer read the stored key: browsers can no longer ring this phone. Create a new key, then link your browsers again.
This phone\'s key cannot be read right now. Try again in a moment.
In the current mode, Sonne would ring silently. Allow alarms in your Do Not Disturb modes.
This code and link open the page of %1$s.
Custom relay: the page of %1$s will receive this phone\'s key. Only use it if you trust that server.
On a browser synced with an account, prefer pasting the link or typing the 12 words in the page: a link opened directly stays in the history.

Write these 12 words on paper or in your password manager: they let you ring this phone from any browser, even on someone else\'s device. The code, the link and the words are the same key: anyone who has them can ring it too. Keep them to yourself.
Creates a new key. Every paired browser loses access.
Browsers already paired will no longer be able to ring this phone. You will need to pair them again.
The reference relay is sonne.sidali.dev. You can host your own. Changing the address means linking your browsers again from that relay\'s page.
Ringing stops by itself after this delay, from 1 to 10 minutes.
Sonne rings this phone from a browser, even in silent mode. A few settings and you are done.
To ring even in silent mode and stay reachable without Google, Sonne needs a few settings. Each button opens the right system screen.
To show the ringing screen and the small standby notification.
To lift Do Not Disturb while ringing. It is restored afterwards.
So that Android does not cut the relay connection while the phone sleeps.
Full screen over the lock screen
To show the Stop button over the lock screen.
Bluetooth beacon: search mode, not emitting yet
Bluetooth beacon: turned off in Settings
This phone cannot be found nearby or rung over Bluetooth while Bluetooth is off. The relay still works.

Walk around: the gauge and the beeps tell you when you get closer. This screen asks your phone, through the relay, to turn on its beacon for 10 minutes. Ring goes over Bluetooth when the phone is in range, through the relay otherwise.
Add the phone you want to find: scan its pairing code, paste its link or type its 12 words.
This device has no Bluetooth Low Energy: ringing goes through the relay only.
To detect your phone\'s beacon and ring it over Bluetooth. Sonne does not use your location.
Turn on Bluetooth to detect your phone nearby. Ring still works through the relay.
Not seen yet. Keep walking around.
Seen %1$d s ago, last signal %2$d dBm
Bluetooth search refused by Android (code %1$d). Trying again shortly.
In range: over Bluetooth, without Internet
Out of range: through the relay
A beep that speeds up as you get closer, on the notification volume.
The signal depends on walls, pockets and phone models: the gauge guides you, it does not measure a distance.
The phone is offline: the command waits on the relay (15 min at most).
Too many commands. Try again in a minute.
Could not reach the phone, neither over Bluetooth nor through the relay.
Could not reach the phone to stop it, neither over Bluetooth nor through the relay.
The phones you can find and ring from here. Same key as in the web page: the pairing code, link or 12 words shown in the Your key tab of that phone.
Paste a link or the 12 words
The camera is only used to read the code, nothing is recorded. The keys are stored encrypted on this phone.
Neither a Sonne link nor 12 valid words.
This link uses an unsecured relay (http://). An https:// address is expected.
Camera not allowed: paste the link or type the 12 words instead.
Identifier: %1$s. Check that it matches the identifier shown in the Your key tab of that phone.
This phone is already in the list.
This is this phone\'s own key: add it on another phone.
You will need its pairing code, link or 12 words to add it again.
Android can no longer read the list of your other phones. Empty it, then add them again.
Every phone of this list will be forgotten on this phone. Their keys do not change.

Lets your other phones find this one nearby and ring it without Internet. The beacon only emits for 10 minutes after a command (ring, stop, or a search from Nearby), or when this phone has been offline for an hour. Its identifier changes every 15 minutes.
When looking for another phone with Nearby.
For Nearby: your other phones can find this one over Bluetooth and ring it without Internet, and this phone can look for them. No location.
Bluetooth beacon: standby. It turns on when you look for this phone.
While the beacon emits, any device nearby can read this phone\'s Bluetooth name. Give it a neutral name (Settings, Connected devices) rather than your first name.
Anyone who has these 12 words, this code or this link can also tell when this phone is nearby while its Bluetooth beacon emits, and can make it emit by sending a command.
Waking the beacon through the relay…
Beacon wake-up delivered: the phone emits for 10 minutes.
The phone is offline: its beacon turns on by itself after an hour without the relay.
Relay unreachable from here: the phone\'s beacon only turns on after a command from a browser, or after an hour offline.
Several beacons send this phone\'s identifier at the same time: someone may be copying it. The gauge follows the strongest one.
Written over Bluetooth, but no acknowledgement came back and the relay could not be reached.

The \"Turn off Bluetooth automatically\" option switches Bluetooth off when no device is connected, and the beacon with it, most likely right when this phone is lost. Turn it off in the Bluetooth settings.
Automatic Bluetooth turn-off is on here: it may cut Bluetooth during the search.
Tells you when a new version of Sonne is available.
Sonne %1$s is available. Tap to download and install it.
You have version %1$s. The update keeps your key, your settings and your paired browsers.
To update itself, Sonne needs the \"Install unknown apps\" permission. Android still shows the update and asks for your confirmation: nothing is installed without you.
Checking the file and its signature…
Confirm the installation on the Android screen.
Download failed. Check your connection and try again.
Download refused: the file is far too large to be Sonne.
Update refused: the downloaded file does not match the published checksum. It was deleted.
Update refused: the file is not signed with the same key as the installed app. It was deleted.
Update refused: the file is not the announced version of Sonne. It was deleted.
Not enough free space to download the update.
Android could not install the update.
Once a day and when the app opens, Sonne asks %1$s whether a new version exists. Nothing about you is sent. Each update is checked (checksum and signature) and installed only after your confirmation.
An update is available: see the Home tab.
Could not check for updates. Try again later.
These 12 words link your devices to this phone. Nobody, not even us, can recover them for you.
Scan this code with the device that will ring this phone, or open the link on it.
Save it in your password manager, or keep the rescue kit somewhere safe. Then check it in 10 seconds.
You can link a new device or reinstall Sonne without losing anything.
No password manager answered. Use the rescue kit, or copy the words into it by hand.
Type words %1$d, %2$d and %3$d of your key.
That does not match. Look at your backup and try again.
Your key is not backed up yet
If you lose this phone or reinstall Sonne, you would have to pair every device again.
Keep this page private. Anyone who has these words can ring this phone. To pair a new device, scan the code or type the 12 words at %1$s.
Ring this phone from anywhere, even in silent mode.
Your browsers and other phones can ring this phone.
While off, this phone can\'t be rung or found.
No account. No tracking. No ads.
Nothing leaves your device unless you choose it.
The code will be published, so anyone can check this.
Internal review. No external audit yet.
Fonts: Bricolage Grotesque and Figtree, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (included in the app).
No e-mail app found. Write to %1$s.
Battery, ringing or not, phone model and app version. Only your paired browsers and phones can read it.

Ring, stop and status checks, from your browsers and other phones. Every command is a message of the same size: the relay cannot tell them apart. Nobody without your key can send or read one. A phone still on Sonne 1.5 or older gets the old format, signed only, until it updates.

A random chain id, message sizes (the same for every command), times, and your IP address while connected. It never sees the content. It writes nothing to disk: waiting commands are dropped after 15 minutes, the last seen time after 24 hours.
On sonne.sidali.dev, the web server in front of the relay logs each request (IP address, time, path, never the chain id) for 7 days.
Once a day and when the app opens, a request for the latest version number, and the download if you install it. No identifier is sent. You can turn it off in Settings.
no, but unreadable without your key
Only for 10 minutes after a command, while ringing, or after an hour without the relay. Its id changes every 15 minutes. You can turn it off in Settings.
depends on where you save it
Your password manager, a rescue kit PDF, or the clipboard, only when you tap one of them.
Nothing else. No account, no analytics, no crash reports, no Google services.
Deletes your key, your settings and your other phones from this phone, and destroys the encryption keys.

Your key, your settings and your other phones are deleted from this phone, and its encryption keys are destroyed. Paired browsers and phones will no longer reach it. The relay has no erase command, so Sonne leaves the chain: the relay keeps nothing on disk and forgets this phone within 24 hours. Sonne then closes and starts fresh next time.
What Sonne uses, and why. Tap a row to turn it on, or to turn it off in Settings. Sonne adapts when you come back.
Granted at install, nothing to switch: internet, background connection, start at boot and vibration. The flashlight needs no permission. Sonne never asks for your location.
What Sonne uses and why. Turn each one on or off.
Paused: Nearby devices is off. Turn it back on in Permissions.
Off: the ringing screen and the standby notification will not show.
Off: the Stop button will not show over the lock screen.
Off: in Do Not Disturb, Sonne may stay silent.
Off: Android may cut the connection while the phone sleeps, so a ring can come late.
Off: the beacon and the Nearby search are paused. The relay still works.
To scan the QR code of another phone in My other phones. Nothing is recorded.
Off: paste the other phone\'s link instead of scanning it.
So Sonne can update itself. Android still shows each update and asks you first.
Off: Sonne tells you when an update is out, but cannot install it.
